title: 简易日式麻将
description: A lightweight Japanese mahjong game for enthusiasts and beginners alike. With a clear 3D table view, a variety of popular match formats, helpful winning-hand hints, and detailed scoring breakdowns, the game makes it easier to understand the state of play, learn the rules, and improve your skills. In addition to playing against the computer, you can create an online room and invite friends using a room code for four-player  or three-player matches. Match replays let you review key discards and reflect on your offensive and defensive decisions. Whether you’re new to Japanese mahjong, looking for a quick practice match, or eager to test your skills against friends, enjoy a simple, straightforward, ad-free mahjong experience.
description_short: Enjoy Japanese mahjong on a clear 3D table, with winning-hand hints and detailed scoring. Play against the computer or invite friends to online four-player or three-player matches. Review replays to improve your skills. Simple, ad-free fun for beginners and enthusiasts.
